description: Track public reviews, developer replies, languages and rating changes for Google Workspace Marketplace apps. Use app IDs/URLs for a watchlist, or search the public Marketplace index by keyword.

appIds.description: Numeric App IDs or full Google Workspace Marketplace app URLs. Add one app per item. Example: 1008170693301 or https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/mailmeteor_mail_merge_for_google_sheets/1008170693301. Used by the 'Reviews for specific apps' mode.
appIds.title: App IDs or URLs

maxApps.description: How many top matching apps to track for each search keyword.
maxApps.title: Max apps per keyword

maxItems.description: Maximum number of review rows to return across all apps (1–5000).
maxItems.title: Max reviews per run

maxRating.description: Only include reviews with this star rating or lower (1–5). Leave blank for all ratings.
maxRating.title: Maximum star rating

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Stop after this many matching reviews for each app (1–2000). Raise it to collect full history; the Marketplace serves 10 per page.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app

minAppRating.description: Skip apps rated below this value (0–5). Use 0 for no app-rating filter.
minAppRating.title: Minimum app rating

minAppReviews.description: Skip apps with fewer total reviews than this. Use 0 for no app-review-count filter.
minAppReviews.title: Minimum app review count

minRating.description: Only include reviews with this star rating or higher (1–5). Leave blank for all ratings.
minRating.title: Minimum star rating

mode.description: Choose 'Reviews for specific apps' to watch an app list, or 'Search apps by keyword' to discover popular Marketplace apps.
mode.title: What to track

outputMode.description: Use 'Only new reviews' or 'New + changed reviews' with a state key to compare this run with the previous run.
outputMode.title: Monitor output

resetState.description: Clear the saved snapshot before this run so every review is treated as new.
resetState.title: Reset monitor before run

reviewKeyword.description: Only include reviews whose text contains this phrase (case-insensitive). Leave blank for all review text.
reviewKeyword.title: Review text contains

reviewLanguage.description: Choose a language, or 'All languages' to check every supported language slice until Max reviews per app is reached.
reviewLanguage.title: Review language

searchQueries.description: Keywords for the 'Search apps by keyword' mode, for example 'mail merge' or 'crm'. Each keyword ranks the Marketplace's public app index; niche apps should be added by ID or URL instead.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sinceDate.description: Only include reviews posted on or after this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or a period such as '30 days', '2 weeks' or '6 months'. Leave blank for all dates.
sinceDate.title: Reviews on or after

sortBy.description: Order in which to retrieve reviews. The Marketplace supports newest and most helpful; legacy rating sorts are computed over the collected reviews.
enumTitles: Most relevant (legacy alias for most helpful)
Highest rated first (computed over collected reviews)
Lowest rated first (computed over collected reviews)
sortBy.title: Sort reviews by

stateKey.description: Name of the saved snapshot. Use a different name for each schedule or watchlist. Leave blank to derive one from the app list and review language.
stateKey.title: Monitor name (state key)

trackChanges.description: In 'All matching reviews' mode, add isNew/changeTypes and save a snapshot for the next run.
trackChanges.title: Track changes in All mode

untilDate.description: Only include reviews posted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank for no end date.
untilDate.title: Reviews on or before

title: Google Workspace Marketplace Review Tracker Input
